Behind every wagging tail at Villalobos Rescue Center lies a hard-fought battle for survival. When sick, injured, or neglected pit bulls arrive at the gates, Tia Torres and her crew step in to rebuild their broken lives. As each dog recovers its strength and learns to feel safe around people once more, the biggest test still lies ahead: meeting potential adopters. Will these resilient rescue dogs win over new families and claim the loving homes they deserve?
Watch Pit Bulls & Parolees, Season 8b, Episodes 16, 20, 13, 12, 18, 17 and 15, on Animal Planet India.
